messages.en:
{07 1c 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.Sigh. Whenever it rains,
it makes me feel like I did
when I was a little girl.
{07 16 00}I was so innocent back
then, before I learned the
cruel ways of the world.
messages.et:
{07 1c 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.Ohh. Iga kord kui sajab,
tunnen ma end nagu siis,
kui olin väike tüdruk.
{07 16 00}Ma olin siis nii süütu,
enne kui õppisin tundma
maailma julmi viise.

messages.en:
{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Good afternoon{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 05 00}
How are you, {04 1f 00}?{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 14 00}I{01 00 00 0a 00} kinda like rainy days.
{07 13 00}I pretend that the pitter-
patter of the rain is the
soundtrack to a movie{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 19 00}And I am the star!{07 14 00}{01 00 00 0a 00} Well,
that kinda goes without
saying, {04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Tere päevast{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 05 00}
Kuidas läheb, {04 1f 00}?{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 14 00}Mulle{01 00 00 0a 00} meeldivad vihmased
päevad. {07 13 00}Ma teesklen, et
vihma sabin on filmi
heliriba{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 19 00}Ja mina olen täht!{07 14 00}{01 00 00 0a 00} Noh,
see on niigi
selge, {04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Hi{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 05 00}
{01 00 00 05 00}{07 00 00}You know, {04 02 00}, I
kinda like the rain.
I mean, I like the rain when
I'm sitting inside, 'cause
it's all toasty and warm.
{07 16 00}But I {01 00 00 05 00}HATE the rain when I'm
standing outside, 'cause it
messes up my makeup. Ick!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Tere{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 05 00}
{01 00 00 05 00}{07 00 00}Tead, {04 02 00}, mulle
meeldib vihm.
Tähendab, mulle meeldib
vihm, kui ma istun toas,
sest seal on soe ja mõnus.
{07 16 00}Aga ma {01 00 00 05 00}VIHKAN vihma, kui ma
seisan väljas, sest see
rikub mu meigi ära. Öök!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Good evening, {04 1f 00}.
{07 16 00}It was really pouring down
all day,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 02 00}!
{07 08 00}I got my new outfit all wet!
Ugh! The whole ordeal was
terribly traumatizing.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Tere õhtust, {04 1f 00}.
{07 16 00}Terve päev kallas
kui oavarrest,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 02 00}!
{07 08 00}Mu uus rõivas sai märjaks!
Öök! Kogu see katsumus oli
kohutavalt traumeeriv.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}

messages.en:
{07 04 00}It's {04 08 00} o'clock already!? {01 00 00 05 00}I
was supposed to reapply my
lipstick ten minutes ago!
{07 16 00}It's so easy to lose track
of time when the sun isn't
out, {04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Kell on juba {04 08 00}!? {01 00 00 05 00}Ma
pidin kümme minutit tagasi
huulepulka uuendama!
{07 16 00}Nii lihtne on ajataju
kaotada, kui päikest
pole, {04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Oh, good evening{01 07 00}.{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 0b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}If it's raining now,{01 00 00 05 00} does
that mean rain tomorrow?
{07 01 00}I'm tired of rain! {07 16 00}I want
the sun to come out
already, {04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Oi, tere õhtust{01 07 00}.{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 0b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Kui praegu sajab,{01 00 00 05 00} kas see
tähendab homme ka vihma?
{07 01 00}Ma olen vihmast tüdinud! {07 16 00}Ma
tahan, et päike juba
välja tuleks, {04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Good evening, {04 1f 00}.
{07 1c 00}{01 00 00 14 00}This type of rain at this
particular hour...
{07 16 00}Well, {01 00 00 05 00}it just makes me feel
lonely, is all.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}

{07 14 00}But then I saw your face,
and now I feel OK. You're
the best, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Tere õhtust, {04 1f 00}.
{07 1c 00}{01 00 00 14 00}Selline vihm sellisel
kellaajal...
{07 16 00}Noh, {01 00 00 05 00}see teeb mind lihtsalt
üksildaseks, ongi kõik.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}

{07 14 00}Aga siis nägin sinu nägu
ja nüüd on kõik hästi. Sa
oled parim, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
